outcome: Maternal complications (Postpartum haemorrhage, Eclampsia, Antepartum haemorrhage due to Abruptio placentae, Acute Renal Failure, Pulmonary oedema, HELLP syndrome, DIC, maternal death, PRES)

Perinatal complications (prematurity, Low birth weight, Low Apgar score, Meconium aspiration syndrome, NICU admission, Requirement of ventilation, Early neonatal death, Intrauterine fetal death, Perinatal mortality)
Placental histopathological findings (Calcification, Infarction, Hematoma, Stromal fibrosis)
cohort: 100 antenatal women admitted with severe preeclampsia.
finding: Patients with severe preeclampsia have a high risk of life-threatening maternal and perinatal complications.
